title: Does AI need an antitrust exemption so it doesn’t kill everyone????
slides: AI labs warn: regulation now could kill everyone
They want immunity from antitrust rules to build safely
But no one can define safe when competing for speed
Your next AI tool may depend on this legal fight
Ask who gets immunity, and who decides
thread_text:
1. AI labs demand immunity

They want exemption from antitrust laws to build safely. But no one defines what safe means while racing.

2. Safety or speed?

Companies say regulation could kill everyone. Yet they compete to release faster than rivals.

3. The undefined word

No shared definition of safe exists. Each lab interprets it differently under pressure.

4. Your tools at stake

Future AI products depend on this legal battle. If immunity passes, oversight shrinks.

5. Who decides?

Ask who gets immunity and who sets the rules. Does that make sense for your next AI tool?
